recipe.visualDefinition: A four-panel grid composition featuring high-contrast, black-and-white portraits. The imagery alternates between sharp, centered subjects in formal attire and abstract, heavily shadowed figures with obscured features, all unified by a dense, gritty film grain and extreme chiaroscuro lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between top-left and bottom-right sharp portraits
Diagonal balance between top-right and bottom-left abstract silhouettes
Uniform heavy grain texture across all four quadrants
Stark white highlights against deep, absolute black shadows
coreInvariants: Heavy digital or film grain noise
Obscured eyes or faces in at least two panels

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered within their respective quadrants, primarily framed from the chest up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The two clear portraits in the top-left and bottom-right act as the primary anchors for the viewer's gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A diagonal flow from top-left to bottom-right, punctuated by the abstract textures in the opposing corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black negative space surrounds the subjects, creating a sense of isolation and depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Absolute Black (#000000) for backgrounds and deep shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure White (#FFFFFF) for highlights and textured grain.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: None; the impact relies entirely on tonal contrast.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast with minimal gradient transitions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 2x2 grid of high-contrast black and white portraits. Top-left and bottom-right should feature men in suits with dreadlocks and sunglasses/headbands under harsh top-down lighting. Top-right and bottom-left should feature abstract, grainy silhouettes of figures with faces obscured by shadows or fabric. Apply a heavy, uniform film grain across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, wide-tracked sans-serif in white, placed either in the center intersection or at the very bottom margin to maintain the stark composition.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture consistent across all four panels?
Are the shadows deep black without visible detail?
Is the contrast high enough to eliminate most mid-gray tones?

adjustableVariables: Degree of facial obscuration in abstract panels

avoid: Low-resolution pixelation instead of intentional grain

postGenerationChecks: Check for absolute black levels in the background.
Ensure the grain does not blur the sharp edges of the suit lapels.
Verify the diagonal relationship between the clear and abstract portraits.
Confirm the absence of any color artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a 2x2 grid of high-contrast monochrome portraits using extreme chiaroscuro lighting and heavy film grain. Alternate between sharp, centered subjects and abstract, shadowed silhouettes to create a balanced, noir-inspired composition.
